title: AppSpec
description: A declarative app (FR-AGT-16, ADR-0029 decision 9): JSON that a unit writes and the artifact store keeps as an application/json version with origin unit, and that fixed web code renders at an owner-only route. Nothing in it is ever run as code or markup, and no link or URL comes from it. 1.0.0 has one kind, quiz: single-answer multiple-choice questions under one countdown timer, each citing the stored file it came from. Rules the schema cannot express are AS-01 to AS-04 in appspec.rules.md.

title.description: The quiz's name, shown as plain text.

timer.description: One countdown for the whole attempt, in seconds (1 minute to 6 hours). The person may pause it; at 0 the attempt is submitted. The clock is the person's own, so it emits no event.

question.description: One question. answer is the id of the one correct option and always names an option the question has. topic is an optional tag the person can filter by.

question_id.description: q1 to q999, unique within the spec (AS-01).

stem.description: The question text, shown as plain text (AS-03).

option_text.description: One choice, shown as plain text (AS-03).

options.description: Two to six choices keyed a to f and shown in that order: a and b always, each later id only with the one before it.

source.description: Where the question came from: a stored version in the spec's own world, made by a fetch or an upload (AS-02), and for a PDF the page. The web shows the publisher from that version's manifest, never from the spec (AS-03).
